objective: Refactor parse_config in src/utils/config.py to improve readability and reduce cyclomatic complexity while preserving behavior.

implementation.summary: Defaults and field parsing are now separated into DEFAULT_CONFIG, private parser helpers, and CONFIG_PARSERS. parse_config validates the raw object, copies defaults, and applies configured parsers for present keys.
